about: Paper accounts (bullet, dated). Paper only: no account here ever sends an order (ADR-0001). An account takes a signal only from setups it accepts and only when its risk rules allow; every refusal is journaled with the reason. Changing an account's money or limits needs Mandeep's say-so and a CHANGELOG line.

accounts.name: Shadow: every signal of every setup (grading only)
Sniper: index, only setups on trial or live, strict risk
